name: Chicken & Mushroom Fettuccine over Zucchini Pasta

instructions.primary_message: Wash the zucchini and mushrooms. Trim the zucchini ends and using a julienne peeler (or regular peeler) peel into noodle-like sticks; transfer to a large bowl. Thinly slice the mushrooms; transfer to a small bowl. Peel and mince the garlic; transfer to a small bowl.
instructions.secondary_message:
6 medium zucchini squash
0.341 kg white mushrooms
9 cloves garlic

instructions.primary_message: Heat a sauté pan over medium heat.
Slice the chicken in half horizontally to form thin fillets. Season both sides with salt and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
0.681 kg chicken breasts, boneless skinless
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Melt butter in the sauté pan and swirl to coat bottom. Add chicken and cook until golden brown and cooked through, 2-3 minutes per side. Transfer to a plate.
Coarsely grate 1 ½ cup of Parmesan.
Once the chicken has been removed, melt remaining butter in the sauté pan. Add the garlic and cook until fragrant, 15-30 seconds.
Add the sliced mushrooms and cook, stirring occasionally, until softened, 2-3 minutes.
Add the cream and bring to a simmer. Stir in the cheese, salt, and pepper.
instructions.secondary_message:
354 ml (1 ½ cup) heavy cream
¾ tsp salt
¾ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Add the zucchini noodles to the sauce and gently toss until well coated.
Slice the chicken crosswise on an angle.
To serve, place fettuccine alfredo in a bowl or on a plate, top with chicken, and garnish with freshly ground pepper. Enjoy!
